name: r5-l60-kill-control
description: THE FIRST LIVE KILL, arm 1 of 2 — the presses REMOVED. Identical to `r5-l60-kill` in every field but `inputs`. Both jellyfish live, so `Game.totalEnemies()` never reaches 0, `Lock.checkEnemies` never activates, and the lock keeps `type = "Solid"`: the walk PINS at x = 126, one pixel of player box short of the lock's [128,144) face. Without this arm "the walk got through" is not evidence that anything was ever in the way.
